The current figures are too close to neighbours. SHRINK EVERY FIGURE TO 72% OF ITS CURRENT SIZE, using precisely the SAME shrink factor for all six, and arrange at the exact centres of an invisible regular 3-column by 2-row grid. Canvas stays exactly 1536x1024, transparent alpha. Each cell is 512x512. Horizontal character centres are x=256,768,1280. Feet baselines are y=422 for the top row and y=934 for bottom row. Keep the feet of all six figures aligned this way and the body scale identical. All tails, wide wings, ears, clothing and stars must fit with abundant transparent space around, at least 60 pixels on every cell edge. Empty transparent rows between the two groups and empty transparent columns between the three groups. NO change to face, shape, pose, colours, level accessories, or rendering. NO text, no backgrounds, no shadows, no outlines, no frames. Leave plenty of genuinely transparent unused space; this is a production atlas for exact rectangular slicing, not a densely packed illustration. Preserve current transparency.

requests.prompt: Use case: background-extraction and identity-preserving compositing. EDIT THE SUPPLIED APPROVED CHARACTER SHEET into a game-ready TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas, exact canvas 1536 by 1024 pixels, exactly THREE columns by TWO rows of invisible 512x512 cells. The six approved appearances must stay in their exact original order: levels 0,1,2 top row, levels 3,4,5 bottom row. Remove ALL lettering, title, captions, divider lines, paper background, decorations on borders, and all ground/drop shadows. Entire background must be genuine transparent alpha, not white, not ivory, not checkerboard. Keep all SIX complete pets, exactly one per cell, and preserve the original approved face, expression, body anatomy, pose, colours, fur/scales, costumes and every meaningful accessory. Level zero has no ornaments. Do not invent or remove costume accessories at other levels. Keep ears, tail, wings, paws, cloak hems and crown fully intact. Each pet body must retain the SAME scale, position, pose and feet baseline across all six cells; costumes add to the outline, not to body size. Every sprite including its costume and restrained final-level stars must fit completely inside the center 424x424 area of its cell, leaving at least 44px of fully empty transparent padding on every cell edge. Feet baseline at local y=444 for each cell; body horizontal centre at local x=256. No overlap between cells. Do not add a border or any text. Use the exact glossy detailed friendly fantasy illustration style of the approved sheet with clean antialiased edges; isolate the fur and accessory edges carefully, no dark or pale matte halos. Important: these are six separate FULL BODY character cutouts, no circle crops, no frames, no clipped ears or wings. Preserve design, only prepare a clean evenly aligned transparent production atlas.
